name: Swap – Registro de Atualização de PU / Fator
manual_section: 4.2.12 Registro de Atualização de PU / Fator
description: Layout used to update curves referenced in VCP, for Libor with FX variation expressed in other currencies, to report the FX variation expressed in other currencies of the TJMI, for Forward Contracts (valid only for entries made from the registration date up to D-1 of the contract start) and for Cupom Limpo on curves referenced in MOEDA.
file_name_rule: ACCRUAL_<VIEW>-<LOB>.txt (VIEW = BANCO / LAWTON / ATACAMA; LOB = CEM / EDG / HYB / COMM), unique-suffixed, written to the Batch Conecta folder and (best-effort) to the Regulatory Accrual evidence folder of the day
notes: Also to be implemented for Daily Settlements · Other Products · Swap · VCP (/other-products-swap-vcp) — not wired yet. One accrual row generates 1/2/4 records — one per updater view (BANCO always; LAWTON/ATACAMA added when the group counterparty account belongs to them) × VCP leg; records are split by view into separate files. The generator assigns role/curve '01' to the LARGER account number and '00' to the smaller, while the manual states the participant with the SMALLER account is ponta 01. Only the Fator is sent — the PU field is written blank (22 spaces).
